newsitem.title: USA: Clinton says probe needed of China funds charge.
newsitem.headline: Clinton says probe needed of China funds charge.

text.p: President Bill Clinton said on Thursday allegations that China sought to funnel campaign contributions to his Democratic party were "very serious" and needed to be thoroughly investigated.

"It would be a very serious matter for the United States if any country were to attempt to funnel funds to one of our political parties for any reason whatosever. So I think we have to let the investigation proceed," Clinton said.

The Washington Post reported in its Thursday editions that a Justice Department probe into improper political fund-raising activities had uncovered evidence that the Chinese Embassy was used to plan contributions to the Democratic National Committee.
Clinton said he first learned of the allegations on Wednesday evening and knew nothing about them. "They obviously have to be thoroughly investigated," he said.

The Post said its sources declined to provide details about the scope of the evidence relating to the alleged efforts by Chinese representatives to funnel money to the Democratic Party. They also declined to specify what foreign contributions might have been involved, but they said the new evidence was serious.
